outcome: High N-terminal pro-brain natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) level
cohort: The study included 187 neonates diagnosed with COVID-19 in China between December 11, 2022, and January 12, 2023.
finding: After the release of the COVID-19 epidemic situation in China, more neonatal cases with severe COVID-19 presented with high ALT and NT-proBNP levels, and despite few specific medical interventions, the short-term outcome was satisfying.
followup_time: Median length of stay (LOS) of four days, focusing on short-term outcomes during hospitalization.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for cases between December 11, 2022, and January 12, 2023.
